record.paper_title: Gradings, Braidings, Representations, Paraparticles: Some Open Problems
record.original_question: When one decomposes the graded tensor-product representations built for PB and PF, do irreducible components appear beyond the known p-Fock-like modules? In other words, can these decompositions produce direct summands or more general submodules that are not equivalent to the standard p-Fock-like representations?

evidence.quote: In [103] we have proved that the p-Fock-like modules are contained as irreducible factors of such graded, tensor product representations. However, it remains to see whether such decompositions can produce as direct summands or more generally as submodules other non-equivalent representations as well.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $P_B$ denote the parabosonic algebra and $P_F$ the parafermionic algebra (the unital associative $\mathbb{C}$-algebras generated, respectively, by parabosonic creation/annihilation generators $b_i^\pm$ and parafermionic creation/annihilation generators $f_i^\pm$ subject to the Green trilinear relations). Each of $P_B$ and $P_F$ carries a natural $\mathbb{Z}_2$-grading (with the $+$ and $-$ generators of opposite parity), and for each positive integer $p$ each algebra has a distinguished family of infinite-dimensional irreducible representations, the so-called $p$-Fock-like modules $F_p(P_B)$ and $F_p(P_F)$, on which the $\pm$ generators act as ladder operators on a Fock-type space with vacuum vector annihilated by the $-$ generators and labeled by the order of paraquantization $p$.

Using the $\mathbb{Z}_2$-graded (super) tensor product structure, form the graded tensor product representations $F_{p_1}(P_B) \otimes F_{p_2}(P_B)$ on $P_B$ (where the action is defined via the graded coproduct $\Delta(x) = x \otimes 1 + (-1)^{|\cdot|} 1 \otimes x$ on homogeneous generators), and similarly $F_{p_1}(P_F) \otimes F_{p_2}(P_F)$ on $P_F$. It is known that each $p$-Fock-like module $F_p(P_B)$ (respectively $F_p(P_F)$) appears as an irreducible factor in the decomposition of these graded tensor products.

Question: In the decomposition of the graded tensor product representations $F_{p_1}(P_B) \otimes F_{p_2}(P_B)$ and $F_{p_1}(P_F) \otimes F_{p_2}(P_F)$, do there occur irreducible direct summands, or more generally submodules, that are not isomorphic to any of the standard $p$-Fock-like representations? Equivalently, is the family of $p$-Fock-like modules closed under taking irreducible constituents of graded tensor products, or do genuinely new irreducible representations of $P_B$ and $P_F$ arise this way?
artifact.status_search_result: Searches turned up the original problem listing and related work on Fock-like representations of parabosonic, parafermionic, and Relative Parabose Set algebras, but no published resolution showing whether non-Fock-like irreducible summands or submodules occur in the graded tensor-product decompositions for $P_B$ and $P_F$. The status appears to remain undetermined in the available literature.

status_evidence.title: Gradings, Braidings, Representations, Paraparticles: Some Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: p-Fock-like modules are contained as irreducible factors of such graded, tensor product representations; it remains to see whether such decompositions can produce other non-equivalent representations.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as open; no resolution is stated.

status_evidence.title: Ladder operators, Fock-spaces, irreducibility and group gradings for the Relative Parabose Set algebra
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs an infinite family of inequivalent irreducible Fock-like representations of the Relative Parabose Set algebra parametrized by a positive integer p.
status_evidence.claim: Related work establishes p-Fock-like irreducibles but does not address the existence of additional summands in graded tensor products.
